lyrics:
[Intro: thunder, pounding piano chords, then silence]

[Verse 1: female voice, whispered]
I was carrying the shopping
I was thinking about nothing
There were clouds across the car park
And the first drops started coming

[Verse 2: piano rolling, voice rising]
And the tar let go of summer
And the smell came up like steam
And I stood there with my bags down
In the middle of a dream

[Chorus: full band and orchestra, belted]
Rain on hot pavement, and there you were
Nineteen, laughing, soaked right through
Rain on hot pavement, and there you were
I could taste the cigarettes and you
I had put it all away, I had bricked it in for years
One breath of it, one breath of it
And there you were

[Verse 3: sudden quiet, piano alone]
There was a bus stop, there was a blue coat
There was a song on someone's radio
There was a thing you said that I've been saying
All my life, and didn't know

[Chorus: full band and orchestra, belted]
Rain on hot pavement, and there you were
Nineteen, laughing, soaked right through
Rain on hot pavement, and there you were
I could taste the cigarettes and you
I had put it all away, I had bricked it in for years
One breath of it, one breath of it
And there you were

[Bridge: drums crashing, voice and choir trading]
(Flashes of gold) your hand in the dark
(Flashes of cold) the last time, the park
I let you go, I let you go
I never let you go

[Break: silence, one piano note, whispered]
I wonder if it rains where you are.

[Final Chorus: everything, key up, held last note]
Rain on hot pavement, and here you are
Nineteen, laughing, soaked right through
Rain on hot pavement, and here you are
I can taste the cigarettes and you
I had put it all away, I had bricked it in for years
One breath of it, one breath of it
And here you are

[Outro: rain easing, piano, a car alarm far off]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 66 BPM, 4/4, F major, up to G major for the final chorus. Slow, stormy and theatrical, with sudden silences.

VOICE: Female, a huge, precise, dramatic soprano. She whispers the verses, belts the choruses with long sustained notes and wide vibrato, and trades lines with a choir in the bridge. One whispered line in the break.

INSTRUMENTS: A grand piano played with thundering octaves, a full orchestra, crashing drums with tom rolls, bass, electric guitars sustaining chords, a choir, bells, thunder and rain.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, thunder and piano. 0:18 Verse 1, whispered. 0:48 Verse 2. 1:18 Chorus 1. 2:04 Verse 3, quiet. 2:36 Chorus 2. 3:22 Bridge. 3:50 Break, silence. 4:04 Final chorus, key up. 4:56 Outro, rain easing, ends 5:28.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-1990s theatrical pop-rock: a wall of sound with extreme dynamics, piano and voice larger than life.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The whispered 'I wonder if it rains where you are' in the silence at 3:50.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original's memories are set off by a lover's touch. At fifty they are more often set off by a smell in a supermarket car park, with shopping bags in both hands.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Ordinary, ambushed, overwhelmed, wondering.
